properties.name: Search reads every prose field, and an index built over fewer fields rebuilds itself
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: search_design and topic_report now read 15 prose fields they skipped: a change's rationale and stands_in_for, a requirement's and a constraint's rationale, a dimension assessment's description and evidence, a project's objective, a decision's alternatives, the name of a drift event and of an anchor, and an interface's spec, operations, error_model, endpoint and payload_schema. A test lists every string property as searched or not prose, with a reason. The search index records which fields it was built over (fulltext/built-under.json), and an open that finds a different list, or none, rebuilds it once, so a design written before this release finds the new fields too. search_design's description now says what it reads.
